title: IGVF Lipids Documentation
bodyHtml:
The IGVF Lipids Knowlegde Portal (beta) represents the following data.

Genetic data 

  1. GWAS summary statistics for 5 lipid traits (total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, nonHDL, triglycerides) across 6 ancestries (European, East Asian, Hispanic, African, South Asian, trans-ethnic) from GLGC consortium

Graham et al. (2021) The power of genetic diversity in genome-wide association studies of lipids. Nature.

  1. Fine-mapping results from trans-ethic GWAS summary statistics

Graham et al. (2021) The power of genetic diversity in genome-wide association studies of lipids. Nature.

Functional genomic data

  1. Cis-regulatory elements
  • ENCODE liver cCRE annotations (GTEx case 3, 53-year-old female, right lobe of liver)
  1. Variant-gene links
  • Variant-gene maps related to lipid traits using a model-based protocol to combine various epigenomic variant-gene and peak-gene linking approaches in HepG2 and liver, as well as  colocalization results. Data generated by Harry Zhang (Leslie, Dey labs) and Tabassum Fabiha (Dey lab).
  • Hi-C loops connecting tiles containing variants with significant gene associations from IGVF CRISPRi screen in HepG2 (Rich Sherwood lab) to gene-linked tiles based on two Hi-C datasets in HepG2 (BRloops/ENCODEloops). Data generated by Jiajun Tao and Beatrice Borsari (Gerstein lab).
  1. Peak-gene links
  • Peak-gene links from 10x liver multi-ome data using 4 different methods: ArchR (Granja et al 2021 Nat Genet), Cicero (Pliner et al 2018 Mol Cell), Signac (Stuart et al 2021 Nat Methods) and SCENT (Sakaue et al 2024 Nat Genet). Processed by Elizabeth Dorans (Price lab) using data generated by the Y2Ave team (Kundaje, Engreitz labs and others).

Results from bioinformatic methods

  1. cV2F scores
  • Consensus Variant-to-Function (cV2F) scores that learn an optimal aggregate of functional annotations based on how informative they are for complex diseases. This score assigns a grade of 0 to 1 based on the disease functional importance of a variant. Generated by Tabassum Fabiha (Dey lab) as part of manuscripts in preparation: Fabiha et al. (2024), ENCODE Consortium et al. (2024). 
  • cV2F scores restricted to liver-specific features from the Enformer deep learning model (David Kelley lab), ChromBPNet deep learning model (Anshul Kundaje lab) and DNase allelic imbalance ENCODE (Jeff Vierstra lab). Fabiha et al. (2024), ENCODE Consortium et al. (2024).
  1. Stratified LDSC
  • Global enrichment of functional genomic annotations calculated using stratified LDSC. Finucane et al. (2015) Partitioning heritability by functional annotation using genome-wide association summary statistics. Nature Genetics.
  1. Cross-trait LDSC
  • Cross-trait genetic correlations calculated using cross-trait LDSC. Bulik-Sullivan et al. (2015) An Atlas of Genetic Correlations across Human Diseases and Traits. Nature Genetics.
